column1: MME 2273B - INTRO TO FLUID MECH & HEAT TRN
column2: Course Description: An introduction to fluid mechanics and heat transfer. The fluid mechanics covers fluid properties, fluid statics including buoyancy and stability, one-dimensional fluid dynamics including conservation of mass and energy and losses in pipe networks. Heat transfer covers development of the general energy equation for three dimensions and steady-state conduction in one and two dimensions. Extra Information: 3 lecture hours, 2 tutorial hours, 0.5 laboratory hour
